known.via: English Wikipedia "Montefalco Sagrantino" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: An Umbrian DOCG for wine made from 100% Sagrantino, around Montefalco in the province of Perugia. It is made as an oak-aged dry red (Secco) and a less common sweet red (Passito). It gained DOCG status in 1992.
